meta.title: Slide — sliding puzzles without ads
meta.description: Two sliding puzzles: the fifteen — put the tiles in order or make the picture — and Clear the Way — slide the pieces aside to let the boat, the sofa or the red bar out. No ads, no tracking, no accounts; works without the internet.

home.fifteenNote: Put the tiles in order, or make the picture
home.unblockNote: Slide the pieces aside and let yours out
home.levelsNote: One after another, a little harder as you go

about.title: About the game
about.fifteen: Fifteen: tap a tile in the row or column of the gap and it slides into the gap with the tiles between. The goal is the tiles in order: 1 in the top left corner, then to the right and down, the gap in the bottom right (the Goal button shows it) — or the whole picture. A tile in its place has a ✓. Every board can be solved.
about.unblock: Clear the Way: a piece moves only along its length, as far as it is free. Slide pieces aside to clear the way for yours (with the arrow) to the way out on the right. A move is one piece slid any distance. Every puzzle can be solved, and the game knows the fewest moves.
about.text: No ads, no tracking, no accounts. Everything stays on this device; after the first visit the game works without the internet.
about.keysFifteen: Keys in the fifteen: arrows — between tiles, Enter or Space — slide, H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo.
about.keysUnblock: Keys in Clear the Way: arrows — between pieces, Enter — take a piece, then arrows move it, Enter or Esc — put it down; H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo.
